design: Both trusted producer classes must match the scheduler tenant before service publication.
Only TerminalSchedulerCleanupPending admits new durable response work despite an unsuccessful recovery tick; its original error keeps readiness closed.
All other recovery errors and all shutdown outcomes stop before admission. Runtime publication, coordinator readiness and bounded pass limits remain unchanged.

accepted_limits: A simultaneous admission error is logged while cleanup pending remains the health error. A later clean scheduler tick surfaces a persistent admission error; readiness stays closed throughout.
Startup retries call the pass, which returns immediately while runtime admission is unpublished.
